firstPartyEvidence.finding: SOLVEO Energies presents project-specific renewable-energy development/exploitation; no current public network-wide IRVE charging tariff is published.
SOLVEO is producer of multiple separate project/site IRVE datasets; visible updates are mostly 2024-2025 rather than a current network tariff feed.

supportingObservation: A Sainte-Anastasie station is publicly observed at 0.38 EUR/kWh, but this site-specific observation is not used as network/direct authority.
conclusion: No universal current SOLVEO direct tariff and no deterministic anonymous station/EVSE -> current direct tariff resolver for the historical estate.
reopenCondition: Current SOLVEO producer tariff fields across the estate, exact QR/payment payload, or first-party/AFIR/QualiCharge numeric tariff tied to exact EVSE.
